title: comdirect-fetch: Depot
description: Asset-Allokation und Einzelpositionsentwicklung – KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 2.

panels.title: Asset-Allokation nach Anlageklasse (aktuellste Depotübersicht)
panels.description: Verteilung des Depotwerts nach Anlageklasse (comdirect instrument.staticData.instrumentType) zum letzten bekannten Stand - GitHub-Issue #4. Positionen ohne bekannten Typ (ältere, vor 0.15.0 gespeicherte Snapshots) laufen unter 'Unbekannt'.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE pp.instrument_type
    WHEN 'SHARE' THEN 'Aktie'
    WHEN 'BONDS' THEN 'Anleihe'
    WHEN 'SUBSCRIPTION_RIGHT' THEN 'Bezugsrecht'
    WHEN 'ETF' THEN 'ETF'
    WHEN 'PROFIT_PART_CERTIFICATE' THEN 'Genussschein'
    WHEN 'FUND' THEN 'Fonds'
    WHEN 'WARRANT' THEN 'Optionsschein'
    WHEN 'CERTIFICATE' THEN 'Zertifikat'
    ELSE 'Unbekannt'
  END AS `Anlageklasse`,
  SUM(pp.market_value) AS `Wert`
FROM portfolio_positions pp
WHERE pp.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM portfolio_snapshots ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY `Anlageklasse`
ORDER BY `Wert` DESC

panels.title: Asset-Allokation je Einzelposition (aktuellste Depotübersicht)
panels.description: Verteilung des Depotwerts auf Einzelpositionen zum letzten bekannten Stand. Gruppierung nach Anlageklasse siehe Panel links (GitHub-Issue #4).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pp.display_name AS `Position`, pp.market_value AS `Wert`
FROM portfolio_positions pp
WHERE pp.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM portfolio_snapshots ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY pp.market_value DESC

SELECT pp.display_name AS `Position`, pp.isin AS `ISIN`, pp.instrument_type AS `Anlageklasse`, pp.quantity AS `Stück`, pp.market_value AS `Wert`, pp.acquisition_value AS `Anschaffungswert`, pp.profit_loss AS `Gewinn/Verlust`
FROM portfolio_positions pp
WHERE pp.snapshot_id = (SELECT id FROM portfolio_snapshots ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY pp.market_value DESC

panels.title: Einzelpositionsentwicklung – Kurswert je Position
panels.description: Marktwert je Position über die Zeit, aus portfolio_positions/portfolio_snapshots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, pp.display_name AS metric, pp.market_value AS value
FROM portfolio_positions pp
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON ps.id = pp.snapshot_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Einzelpositionsentwicklung – Gewinn/Verlust je Position
panels.description: Absoluter Gewinn/Verlust zum Anschaffungswert je Position über die Zeit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ps.recorded_at AS time, pp.display_name AS metric, pp.profit_loss AS value
FROM portfolio_positions pp
JOIN portfolio_snapshots ps ON ps.id = pp.snapshot_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ps.recorded_at)
ORDER BY time
